unit.why: A single anecdote: a village couple asks the Maggid for a son, they fail to agree on the payment, the villager angrily trusts in God, and the Maggid declares that he will have a son.

stories.start_quote: ע״ש שבא אל המגיד זצ"ל בן כפר
stories.end_quote: מחמת שסמך על השי״ת בכל לבו וד״ל
stories.summary_en: The Maggid asks a childless villager for 52 gulden (gematria of בן); the villager offers ten, then piles copper coins on the table; when refused, he angrily tells his wife they will rely on God without the Maggid, and the Maggid declares that his words were heard in heaven and he will have a son.
